label: letter t input at original position 3
explanation: Fires only when the input token is the letter t at step 3 (the 4th original token). Every such step activates (dev precision 1.0) at strong, fairly uniform magnitude (~0.55-1.0 of max); that step holds 97% of activation mass. Weak residual firing (~0.07-0.15 of max) when t is input at steps 2 or 4. Never fires on any other token, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (including when t is re-fed or output during copy). No dependence on preceding tokens, L, or repetition was found.

issues: Minor: the missed activations (15.5% of active steps, 2.6% of mass) are all weak firings on t at step 2 or 4, as the explanation says. Only about 10% of t inputs at steps 2 and 4 fire (precision 0.097 for that predicate), so this is a weak, partial spillover to neighbouring positions rather than a rule. It is not enough to change the label.

Checked and confirmed: precision is 1.0 with 0 false positives on test. The feature never fires at the delimiter. Copy-phase firing is 1 step out of 2.7M. 97.3% of mass falls at t=3. Lift is flat across L=4..9. L=3 has no step 3 in the original phase, which explains why it is near zero there. All 19326 dev activations are on in_tok t. Recall is 0.845 because the low quartile of activations comes from the spillover at steps 2 and 4.
